text_block_list.text:
One holiday, while out shopping... I 
spotted two familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Come now, come now, don't be shy~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-This is unacceptable... Something like 
this... could never be allowed...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Great timing. I was just recommending 
a cake shop I know—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please, someone help me...! Nature-san is 
sweetly tempting me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Temptation?! You're someone I know well, 
so I just got a little too enthusiastic 
with my pitch!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, today happens to be an 
"All-You-Can-Eat Event"... So, you know... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, you always work so hard. Surely 
having a piece of cake to unwind won't 
hurt?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However! It is all-you-can-eat, you know?! 
To expect me to exercise restraint before 
such cakes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Look at that cream! It's like primroses 
blooming across a field of fresh, fallen 
snow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"And adorning it, jewel-like fruits. The 
golden syrup dripping down is the very 
breath of civilization...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...*Gulp*. Looks like we've got quite the 
master reviewer on our hands."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just listening is making my stomach growl 
too! Ugh... this sweet temptation!
choice_data_list: …Losing weight won't be easy, you know?
Well now~ very nice~ very nice~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just listening is making my stomach growl 
too! Ugh... this sweet temptation!
choice_data_list: …Losing weight won't be easy, you know?
Well now~ very nice~ very nice~

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, I suppose there's a certain luxury 
in savoring just one single flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed...

And so, the two of them enjoyed a modest 
amount of cake.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uggh... Retribution strikes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...I have made up my mind as well. 
Holding back against this cake would be 
downright rude."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Nature-san! With the spirit of 
charging down the Yodo slope together... 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Agh, whatever happens, happens!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Mmm-!! So good...!!

And so, the two of them enjoyed the cake 
to their hearts' content.
